text: Added a green star next to the gold "leads" star for each skill a player has maxed at 99 (hidden if they have none), shown on the Skill Leaderboard's player headers and next to names in the Activity feed.
Ranker and Grind King no longer exclude each other — the same player can now hold both crowns in the same week.
Compacted the Goals tab into 2 columns, splitting skill goals from quest goals.
Added an alternative matrix view to the Skill Leaderboard, showing each player's own skill grid side by side.
Added Desert and Jungle strykewyrms (Focus sight, Hexcrest) and Cave horror (Black mask) to the Loot tab's tables and simulator.
Added a Loot tab with GWD1 boss drop tables and loot simulators, because I'm going dry and hoping this makes me feel better.
Goals can now be reordered by clicking and dragging.
Added the ability to view previous days individually in the Gains section, across the last week.
Added stars to the activity feed so it can be clearly identified that Bill is superior.

Fixed a hover tooltip getting stuck on screen after navigating away via a nav item.
Clicking a Gains hybrid view row's label now switches the graph to that metric too.
Added a takeover animation when a Weekly Highlights badge changes hands.

Fixed the graph in the Gains hybrid view not animating like the graph view.
Added a spinner to the refresh button.
Added odometer animations to grids and the header.
Added a "Not completed" quest list filter option (covers both in-progress and not-started quests).
Clicking a quest node's title in the dependency map now opens its quick guide directly.
Added the ability to pin questlines to the front of the Quests tab.
Task list difficulty tiers now highlight blue when every requirement for that tier is met.
Added a hybrid view on Gains.
Added this changelog column next to Weekly highlights and the Activity feed.
